questions.text: Who is named alongside Eunice as the grandmother of Timothy in 2 Timothy 1:5?

options.text: Mary, his kinswoman
Lois, his grandmother
Anna, the prophetess
Claudia, his disciple

questions.text: What spirit hath God given unto believers according to 2 Timothy 1:7?

options.text: A spirit of continual fear before the rulers of men
A spirit of worldly wisdom seeking temporal gain
A spirit of power, of love, and of a sound mind
A spirit of doubtful wavering and secret despair

questions.text: What does Paul put Timothy in remembrance to do concerning the gift of God (2 Timothy 1:6)?

options.text: To hide the gift of God from all men
To sell the gift of God for much silver
To offer the gift of God in the temple
To stir up the gift of God which is in him

questions.text: Whose household oft refreshed Paul and was not ashamed of his chain (2 Timothy 1:16)?

options.text: The house of Onesiphorus
The house of Aquila at Rome
The high priest in Judea
The governor of the city

questions.text: Which two men turned away from Paul in Asia according to 2 Timothy 1:15?

options.text: Aristarchus and Marcus
Phygellus and Hermogenes
Tychicus and Trophimus
Carpus and Aristarchus

questions.text: Which three figures does Paul set forth as examples of service in 2 Timothy 2:3-6?

options.text: A priest, a Levite, and a temple scribe
A king, a magistrate, and an elder ruler
A soldier, an athlete, and a husbandman
A merchant, a fisherman, and a shepherd

questions.text: What error concerning the truth did Hymenaeus and Philetus say in 2 Timothy 2:18?

options.text: That the whole law of Moses was made void
That Jesus Christ was not bodily raised up
That circumcision was needful for Gentiles
That the resurrection is past already today

questions.text: What seal is upon the foundation of God according to 2 Timothy 2:19?

options.text: The Lord knoweth them that are his; and, Let every one that nameth Christ depart from iniquity
The Lord is almighty forever; and, Fear the holy name of God and observe all his commandments
The law standeth fast forever; and, Cleave unto all the ancient traditions delivered by fathers
God blesseth only the rich; and, Bring forth all your silver into the storehouse of the temple

questions.text: What vessels are found in a great house according to 2 Timothy 2:20?

options.text: Vessels of brass, iron, stone, and precious crystal
Vessels of gold and of silver, of wood and of earth
Only golden flagons made for the banquets of kings
Only earthen vessels designed for common menial use

questions.text: How must the servant of the Lord behave according to 2 Timothy 2:24?

options.text: Contend with harsh anger against all adversaries
Judge with proud haughtiness over every offender
Must not strive, but be gentle unto all men daily
Enforce his doctrine through worldly magistrates

questions.text: What shall characterize the perilous times of the last days (2 Timothy 3:1-5)?

options.text: By universal worldly peace and great abundance of riches among all kingdoms
By building magnificent temples throughout Asia and worshipping false gods
By the sudden conversion of all gentiles unto the saving truth of the Lord
By lovers of their own selves, covetous, having a form of godliness in vain

questions.text: Which two men withstood Moses according to 2 Timothy 3:8?

options.text: Jannes and Jambres
Dathan and Abiram
Korah and Abiram
Haman and Sanballat

questions.text: From which places did afflictions come unto Paul according to 2 Timothy 3:11?

options.text: At Rome, at Corinth, and at Ephesus
At Antioch, at Iconium, and at Lystra
At Jerusalem, Samaria, and Damascus
At Philippi, Thessalonica, and Berea

questions.text: What is written of all that will live godly in Christ Jesus (2 Timothy 3:12)?

options.text: They shall escape every earthly sorrow
They shall possess great worldly wealth
They shall suffer persecution in faith
They shall be exalted by civil rulers

questions.text: For what is all Scripture given by inspiration of God profitable (2 Timothy 3:16)?

options.text: For studying worldly philosophy and ancient wisdom of the heathen
For the circumcision only, excluding all other nations on earth
For curious fables of men, having no spiritual authority at all
For doctrine, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction

questions.text: What does Paul charge Timothy concerning the word in 2 Timothy 4:2?

options.text: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season, and reprove
Proclaim the word only upon feast days when the multitude gather
Hide the transgressions of men lest any should be offended thereby
Teach only ancestral commandments and avoid any modern doctrine

questions.text: What profession does Paul make at the end of his course (2 Timothy 4:7)?

options.text: I have amassed treasures of gold and established worldly synagogues in Asia
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith
I have escaped from every persecutor and preserved my mortal life in peace
I have overthrown pagan shrines and demolished earthly idols from the land

questions.text: What crown is laid up for Paul and all them that love His appearing (2 Timothy 4:8)?

options.text: The crown of Caesar's empire which the emperor granteth unto loyal servants
A corruptible crown of gold and pearls wrought by the cunning craft of men
A crown of righteousness which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me
The crown of temporal glory which the gentile multitude heapeth upon sages

questions.text: Why did Demas forsake Paul and depart unto Thessalonica (2 Timothy 4:10)?

options.text: Because he was apprehended by Roman soldiers
Because he desired to preach in Macedonia
Because he was sent to buy winter supplies
Having loved this present world and its ways

questions.text: What was Timothy charged to bring from Troas with Carpus in 2 Timothy 4:13?

options.text: The cloke, and the books, but especially the parchments
The iron sword which he required for defence upon the sea
The golden chalice kept with Carpus for the holy supper
The winter tent of skins prepared against the cold season
